message.content:
Bring four DistBench tickets into line with Samyak's approvals of 11 Nov 23:05 PT (relayed; their record commit is pending his morning run of a script, so cite them as "APPROVALS, Seven approvals of 11 November 2026, 23:05 PT (pending record)"), on jhaveris.

Read first: /home/samyak/.local/state/distbench/worktrees/ticket-review/docs/research/2026-11-05-replan/reviews-tickets/SLICE-BRIEF.md (scratch clones, FREEZE, checks, commit rules). Folder: docs/research/2026-11-05-replan/. The approvals, as the lead reads them (the authority until the record lands is /tmp/claude-1000/-home-samyak-distbench/4114e7c2-4b6f-4f6b-a014-2c87309a1685/scratchpad/record-ruling-4.sh's APPROVALS text; read it):
- W70 (and its W71 row): a speed-up task whose given program is already distributed times its given program at the process count it declares, not at one process. The build lead said the timing-code change goes into a build-side ticket J20; make W70's rows name the rule and J20 as the code's owner, and adjust any done check or step that assumed one process.
- W49 part 2: vllm, tutel, dask_ml and sklearn are allowed only in the scratch copy that times tools, installed apart from the agent image; agents keep the full denylist. Make part 2's steps, Must-not and checks say so (a check that the agent image's denylist is unchanged, if one fits).
- W47 row 3: one paid prompt per study model may count one profiled reply's tokens; it was struck. Unstrike it as an attended lead step with that cap (one prompt per model, three models), the model ids from the study, and a check that reads the recorded token counts; the label stays in its own field (W39 is already so; do not edit W39).
- W34 gold set: Astra runs with ~/.codex/AGENTS.md loaded; its sha256 is recorded with each run (already in step 4's logins.txt) and the paper discloses it: add the disclosure line to the report box and a check that the report names the file and its hash.
Do not touch W21, W32, W39, W44, W45 or implementation-plan.md (another worker is editing them now); propose plan edits in your report.
For each changed check: base result unchanged, a planted fault fails, the crash-shim and pstack-read rules hold; `python3 -I stamp_blocks.py --check` and `python3 -I run_ticket_checks.py` on each changed ticket exit 0 in a scratch clone (origin set to git@github.com:SamyakJhaveri/distbench.git). Add a row to each ticket's reviews-tickets record. Commit your paths only, do not push. Append to /home/samyak/.local/state/distbench/evidence/2026-11-11-review/progress.log one line per ticket: "<UTC time> 23:05 approvals -> <ticket>: <commit>".
No sub-agents. Report in at most 120 words: commits, each change in one line, proposed plan edits.
